items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: So finally, I made some orchestrations for her.

ctx.x: I didn't run into Claude until after -- Claude was playing down at the Roseland, and this was in '28, and I got the job at the theatre, see, and I got a band and went into the Lafayette Theatre.

And Ethel Waters was the star, and she didn't have any music, and I said, well, you got to have some orchestration -- and she said, 'My piano player will tell them what to play.' So finally, I made some orchestrations for her.
